answer: Duplicates fail cross-validation, so creating fake identities costs more in hardware and bandwidth than any reward they could earn, making mass sybil registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to physical resource: each agent must submit a unique, verifiable sampling of a river's flow data and a raven's call recording, both geotagged and time-stamped, with a shale-based hardware token that costs real money to forge. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
